theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pf_ext_imrep_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → (∀ j, Continuous (gs j)) → Continuous g → TendstoUniformlyOn gs g atTop K → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (gs j x) ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (g x) ∂μHE[n]))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
